messages:
Carmen: Quick thread to capture decisions we made today about delta ops, finish reasons, and launch scope for streaming API. Keeping it short.
Leo: Main ask from SDK teams: guarantee a single, well-formed final message that carries finish_reason + final_usage. No ambiguity.
Noah: Agree. Runtime constraint: we must not send any more text deltas after the final event. Otherwise clients end up double-appending.
Priya: On transports: we recommend supporting WS + SSE at launch, but document subtle behavioral diffs (e.g., server-initiated control only reliable on WS).
Carmen: Important: we standardize an envelope delta shape so parsing is identical across transports. Example: `{event: "delta", payload: {...}}` and `{event: "finish", payload: {reason, usage, metadata}}`.
Leo: Delta formats we agreed: `plain_v1` (concise text chunks), `ops_v1` (typed ops: insert, delete, function_call, meta), and `annotated_v1` (adds provenance fields). Default = `plain_v1`.
Noah: Function call delivery: treat it as an atomic op in `ops_v1`: `{type: "function_call", name: "search", args: {...}, complete: true}`. If a function_call spans multiple deltas, include `call_id` and `seq` to reassemble.
Priya: Mobile note: SSE may reconnect in background differently. SDKs must expose a resume API and auto-manage token refresh. We'll ship Keychain-backed resume storage on iOS.
Carmen: Finish reasons minimal set: `completed`, `max_tokens`, `policy_block`, `cancelled`, `server_error`, `timeout`. Each finish should have `reason` + optional `reason_details` string and optional `error_code`.
Leo: Telemetry counters: finish_reason histogram, ambiguous_finish_count (should be <0.5% at beta), resume_success_rate (>90%), first_delta_p95 (<200ms for hosted).
Noah: Backpressure semantics: server may emit `X-Stream-Window: n` header and WS PAUSE/RESUME control frames. SSE will get advisory comments `: pause`/`: resume` and clients must obey.
Priya: For SDK UX acceptance tests:
- assert only one final finish event and no subsequent data deltas
- function_call reassembly with out-of-order deltas
- resume with token reuse and short live tokens
- verify metadata preserved across resume
I'll write test vectors.
Carmen: Launch gates checklist (compact):
- SDKs: JS, Python, iOS streaming + resume API
- Runtime: handshake, session_id, resume token signing, PAUSE hooks
- Docs: transport differences, delta examples for all formats, migration guide from non-streaming
- Telemetry: dashboards + alerts for ambiguous finishes
- Beta: 2 external customers + internal support app
Metrics thresholds we set for beta: first_delta_p95 < 200ms, resume_success >= 90%, ambiguous_finish <= 0.5%.
Leo: Rollout plan: dogfood on internal apps -> gated beta with opt-in -> 10% gradual ramp -> GA. Each step requires SDK releases and dashboards.
Noah: I'll follow up with schema JSON for finish event + resume token spec (signed JWT-ish, TTL 5m). Will include examples. Due Fri EOD.
Priya: I'll produce the mobile acceptance checklist and Keychain storage pattern. Due Mon.
Carmen: @deploy-bot schedule: streaming-v0.2-handshake -> staging 2026-04-02T18:30:00Z
deploy-bot: deploy queued: streaming-v0.2-handshake -> staging at 2026-04-02T18:30:00Z :rocket:
Carmen: Thanks team — we'll re-check after the staging deploy and test vectors land.
